title: Loan Age and the Rounding of Interest in a Telephone Payment on an Auto Loan
content:
How the interest in a telephone payment on a loan of the Auto Loans line is rounded follows how long the loan has been on the books, counted in whole months from the date it funded to the day of the payment.

1. Where the loan was funded at least 36 whole months before the payment, the interest is rounded down to the whole dollar.
2. Where the loan was funded at least 24 but less than 36 whole months before the payment, the interest is rounded half-up to the whole dollar.
3. Where the loan was funded less than 24 whole months before the payment, the interest is rounded half-up to the cent.

## The same interest under each convention

Take interest of 124.86 before rounding. On a loan funded 41 whole months before the payment it becomes 124.00. On a loan funded 27 whole months before it becomes 125.00. On a loan funded 9 whole months before it stands at 124.86.

Take interest of 88.20 instead. At 41 whole months it becomes 88.00; at 27 whole months it becomes 88.00, the cents being below the half; at 9 whole months it stands at 88.20.

## The months at which the conventions change

A loan funded exactly 36 whole months before the payment takes the first convention. A loan funded exactly 24 whole months before takes the second. A loan funded 23 whole months before takes the third.
